description: Joint target book → net-delta risk → ledger execution plan from ControllerDiagnostics.

options.content:
**Sources:** `JointTargetBook`, `ControllerDiagnostics.action_pipeline`, `execution_gates`.

**Strategy:** MPC curves discretize into venue target books (local + optional global).
**Risk:** net-delta engine approves the joint target-book transition against the ledger.
**Execution:** per-venue planner diffs approved target vs ledger live orders → keep / cancel / place → rules gateway → router.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts AS "time", 'local' AS metric,
  jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(e.payload->'local'->'orders', '[]'::jsonb))::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE 
  e.event_type = 'JointTargetBook'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
UNION ALL
SELECT e.ts, 'global',
  jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(e.payload->'global'->'orders', '[]'::jsonb))::double precision
FROM mm_events e
WHERE 
  e.event_type = 'JointTargetBook'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Target book order count by venue

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts AS "time",
  books.venue || '_' || COALESCE(books.ord->>'side', '') AS metric,
  SUM((books.ord->>'qty')::double precision) AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT 'local' AS venue, ord
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'local'->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS ord
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'global', ord
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'global'->'orders', '[]'::jsonb)) AS ord
) AS books(venue, ord)
WHERE 
  e.event_type = 'JointTargetBook'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Target book buy/sell qty by venue

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts AS "time", stage AS metric,
  (e.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', stage, 'order_count'])::int::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ARRAY['ladder','venue_quantized','capped']) AS stage
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", 'risk_approved' AS metric,
  (e.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline','risk_approved_target','order_count'])::int::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", 'approved' AS metric,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((e.payload->'risk'->>'approved')::boolean, true) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Execution plan (ledger diff, both venues merged)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts AS "time", stage AS metric,
  (e.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', stage, 'order_count'])::int::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ARRAY['kept','planned_cancel','planned_place','rules_valid','router_accepted']) AS stage
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Planner output: keep / cancel / place / rules / router

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts AS "time", metric,
  (e.payload #>> ARRAY['action_pipeline','planned_place', field])::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN (
  VALUES ('buy_notional', 'buy_notional'), ('sell_notional', 'sell_notional')
) AS legs(metric, field)
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", stage AS metric,
  (e.payload #> ARRAY['action_pipeline', stage, 'order_count'])::int::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ARRAY['kept', 'planned_cancel']) AS stage
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", 'executed' AS metric,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE((e.payload->'execution_gates'->>'executed')::boolean, false) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", gate.key AS metric,
  CASE WHEN (gate.value->>'live')::boolean THEN 1 ELSE 0 END::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
  COALESCE(e.payload->'execution_gates'->'venue_gates', '{}'::jsonb)
) AS gate(key, value)
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = '${exchange}'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1
